q20194.en: The sign shown means that turning left is not allowed.

explain.short: The arrows show only straight on and right, so a left turn is not allowed.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn right, you choose. Turning left is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'non è consentito' (is not allowed) is correct: left is missing from the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Only straight or right: no left turn

q20195.en: The sign shown means that turning right is allowed.

explain.short: One of the two arrows points right, so turning right is allowed.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn right, you choose. Turning left is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'è consentito' (is allowed) does not mean 'is compulsory': right is one of two choices.

sceneParams.caption: Turning right is allowed

q20196.en: The sign shown means that going straight on is allowed.

explain.short: One of the two arrows points straight up, so going straight on is allowed.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn right, you choose. Turning left is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'è consentito' (is allowed): straight on is one of the two allowed choices.

sceneParams.caption: Going straight on is allowed

q20197.en: The sign shown means that you can choose between the two allowed directions.

explain.short: The sign shows two arrows: you may pick straight on or right.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn right, you choose. Turning left is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'si può scegliere' (you can choose): two arrows mean two free choices.

sceneParams.caption: You choose: straight on or right

q20198.en: The sign shown means that you must turn only to the right.

explain.short: Straight on is also allowed, so right is not the only choice.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn right, you choose. Turning left is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'unicamente' (only) is the trap: there are two arrows, not one.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: straight on is also allowed

q20199.en: The sign shown means that you must go only straight on.

explain.short: Turning right is also allowed, so straight on is not the only choice.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn right, you choose. Turning left is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: the right arrow is there too.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: turning right is also allowed

q20200.en: The sign shown means that you must give way to the left.

explain.short: This sign shows allowed directions; it says nothing about giving way.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn right, you choose. Turning left is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'dare la precedenza' (give way) belongs to other signs, like the upside-down triangle.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it shows directions, not give way

q20201.en: The sign shown means that in every case you must keep as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway.

explain.short: The sign only says which directions you may take; it does not tell you to keep to the right edge.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn right, you choose. Turning left is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'in ogni caso' (in every case) and 'margine destro' (right edge) are not on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it only shows the allowed directions

q20202.en: The sign shown means that a dangerous fork is near.

explain.short: A blue disc gives an obligation; a danger warning would be a red triangle.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn right, you choose. Turning left is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'biforcazione pericolosa' (dangerous fork) would need a triangle danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: obligation sign, not a danger sign

q20203.en: The sign shown only allows you to go straight on or turn left.

explain.short: The two arrows show straight on and left; nothing else is allowed.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn left, you choose. Turning right is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is right here: only these two directions.

sceneParams.caption: Only straight on or left

q20204.en: The sign shown does not allow a right turn.

explain.short: There is no right arrow, so turning right is not allowed.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn left, you choose. Turning right is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'non consente' (does not allow): right is missing from the sign.

sceneParams.caption: No right turn: only straight or left

q20205.en: The sign shown requires you to turn left or go straight on.

explain.short: It is an obligation sign: you must take one of the two arrows, left or straight on.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn left, you choose. Turning right is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'obbliga' (requires) fits: you must follow one of the two arrows.

sceneParams.caption: You must go left or straight on

q20206.en: The sign shown means that you must not turn right.

explain.short: Only straight on and left are shown, so you must not turn right.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn left, you choose. Turning right is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'non si deve' (you must not): right is not one of the arrows.

sceneParams.caption: Do not turn right here

q20207.en: The sign shown is a prescription (regulatory) sign.

explain.short: Obligation signs belong to the prescription signs, together with prohibition and priority signs.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn left, you choose. Turning right is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' (prescription): rules you must obey, which includes obligation signs.

sceneParams.caption: Obligation signs are prescription signs

q20208.en: The sign shown is also found outside built-up areas.

explain.short: Junctions exist everywhere, so this sign is used both in towns and outside towns.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn left, you choose. Turning right is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'anche' (also): in towns and outside towns.

sceneParams.caption: Used in towns and outside towns

q20209.en: The sign shown only allows you to go straight on.

explain.short: Turning left is also allowed, so straight on is not the only choice.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn left, you choose. Turning right is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: the left arrow is there too.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: turning left is also allowed

q20210.en: The sign shown means that only turning left is allowed.

explain.short: Going straight on is also allowed, so left is not the only choice.
explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn left, you choose. Turning right is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is the trap: the straight arrow is there too.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: straight on is also allowed

explain.trap: 'passare a sinistra di un cantiere' (pass left of roadworks) belongs to the keep-left sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: directions at a junction, not an obstacle

explain.trap: 'spartitraffico' (traffic divider) is about keep-left / keep-right signs, not this one.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it gives directions, not divider passing

explain.rule: Mandatory directions (blue disc): you must go straight on OR turn left, you choose. Turning right is not allowed.
explain.trap: 'indicazione' (information) signs are usually rectangles; round blue signs are obligations.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is an obligation sign

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: obligation sign, not a danger sign

explain.trap: 'le corsie diventano due' (lanes become two) is a different sign about lanes.

q20224.en: The sign shown requires drivers to pass on the left of an obstacle.

explain.short: The arrow points down to the left: drivers must go past the obstacle on its left side.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'passare a sinistra' (pass on the left): you go on the left, the obstacle stays on your right.

sceneParams.caption: Pass on the left of the obstacle

q20229.en: The sign shown can be preceded by the ROUNDABOUT sign.

explain.short: This sign is placed right at an obstacle; it is not linked to a roundabout warning.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'ROTATORIA' (roundabout) has its own signs; this one is about passing an obstacle.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it marks an obstacle, not a roundabout

q20230.en: The sign shown means a dangerous descent on the left.

explain.short: A blue disc is an obligation: pass on the left. A steep descent is a red triangle danger sign.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'discesa pericolosa' (dangerous descent) would be a triangle danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it means pass on the left

q20231.en: The sign shown requires drivers to turn left.

explain.short: The arrow points down-left: you pass the obstacle on the left and keep going, you do not turn.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'svoltare' (turn) is the trap: it is 'passare' (pass by), not a turn.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: pass on the left, not turn left

q20232.en: The sign shown announces an obligation to turn left ahead.

explain.short: The sign is placed at the obstacle and means pass on the left now; it does not announce a turn.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'preannuncia' (announces ahead) and 'svoltare' (turn) are both wrong here.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: pass on the left here, not a turn

q20233.en: The sign shown means that you must turn right.

explain.short: The arrow points down to the left: you pass the obstacle on the left; there is no right turn.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'destra' (right) is the wrong side, and 'svoltare' (turn) is the wrong action.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: pass on the left, no right turn

q20234.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: A blue disc is an obligation sign: it gives an order, not just information.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'indicazione' (information) signs are usually rectangles; round blue signs are obligations.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is an obligation sign

q20235.en: The sign shown means compulsory passing on the left.

explain.short: This is exactly the name of the sign: 'passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra'.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'passaggio' (passing by) is not 'svolta' (turn).

sceneParams.caption: Compulsory passing on the left

q20236.en: The sign shown orders you not to pass the obstacle on the right.

explain.short: You must pass on the left, so passing the obstacle on its right side is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'non superare a destra' (do not pass on the right) is the same rule said the other way round.

sceneParams.caption: Pass on the left, never on the right

q20237.en: The sign shown means you must pass roadworks on the left side.

explain.short: Roadworks are one of the obstacles this sign is used for: you pass them on the left.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'superare' (go past) here means passing by the obstacle, not overtaking a vehicle.

sceneParams.caption: Pass the roadworks on the left

q20238.en: The sign shown means you must leave the obstacle on your right.

explain.short: When you pass on the left of something, that thing stays on your right.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'lasciare a destra' (leave on your right) = you pass on its left.

sceneParams.caption: Obstacle on your right = you pass on the left

keywords.en: leave the obstacle on your right

q20239.en: The sign shown means an obligation to turn left.

explain.trap: 'svoltare' (turn) is the trap: the turn-left sign has an arrow that bends left.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: pass on the left, not turn left

q20240.en: The sign shown means you must go past the passenger island leaving it on your left.

explain.short: You pass on the left of the island, so the island stays on your RIGHT, not on your left.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'lasciandolo alla propria sinistra' (leaving it on your left) is the opposite side.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the island stays on your right

q20241.en: The sign shown means compulsory direction to the left.

explain.short: 'Direzione obbligatoria' is a turn sign; this one means compulsory passing on the left of an obstacle.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'direzione' (direction) is the trap: the correct word is 'passaggio' (passing).

explain.trap: 'incrocio' (junction) is warned by a red triangle danger sign.

q20243.en: The sign shown means that it is not possible to continue along that road.

explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a sinistra' (keep left): pass on the LEFT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your right. It is not a turn.

q20256.en: The sign shown means you must leave a passenger island on your left.

explain.short: When you pass on the right of the island, the island stays on your left.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a destra' (keep right): pass on the RIGHT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your left. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'lasciare a sinistra' (leave on your left) = you pass on its right.

sceneParams.caption: Island on your left = you pass on the right

q20257.en: The sign shown means you must pass on the right of roadworks.

explain.short: Roadworks are one of the obstacles this sign is used for: you pass them on the right.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a destra' (keep right): pass on the RIGHT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your left. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'passare a destra' (pass on the right) matches the arrow down to the right.

sceneParams.caption: Pass the roadworks on the right

keywords.en: obligation to pass on the right

q20258.en: The sign shown means an obligation to turn right.

explain.short: The arrow points down-right: you pass an obstacle on the right; you do not turn.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a destra' (keep right): pass on the RIGHT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your left. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'svoltare' (turn) is the trap: the turn-right sign has an arrow that bends right.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: pass on the right, not turn right

q20259.en: The sign shown means you must go past the obstacle leaving it on your right.

explain.short: You pass on the right of the obstacle, so it stays on your LEFT, not on your right.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a destra' (keep right): pass on the RIGHT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your left. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'lasciandolo alla propria destra' (leaving it on your right) is the opposite side.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the obstacle stays on your left

q20260.en: The sign shown means compulsory direction to the right.

explain.short: 'Direzione obbligatoria' is a turn sign; this one means compulsory passing on the right of an obstacle.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a destra' (keep right): pass on the RIGHT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your left. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'direzione' (direction) is the trap: the correct word is 'passaggio' (passing).

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: compulsory passing, not direction

q20261.en: The sign shown means that we are near a junction.

explain.short: The sign is placed at an obstacle in the road, not to warn of a junction.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a destra' (keep right): pass on the RIGHT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your left. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'incrocio' (junction) is warned by a red triangle danger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it marks an obstacle, not a junction

q20262.en: The sign shown means that it is not possible to continue along that road.

explain.short: You do continue: you just pass the obstacle on the right.
explain.rule: 'Passaggio obbligatorio a destra' (keep right): pass on the RIGHT of the obstacle, so the obstacle stays on your left. It is not a turn.
explain.trap: 'non è possibile proseguire' (you cannot continue) would be a no-entry sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: you continue, passing on the right

q20263.en: The sign shown tells the driver the only passages allowed.

explain.short: This sign is called 'passaggi consentiti': it shows the only ways you may pass, left or right of the obstacle.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'unici' (only) is right: you may pass only where the arrows point.

sceneParams.caption: The arrows show the only ways through

q20264.en: The sign shown indicates the passages allowed on the right and on the left of a traffic island.

explain.short: The two arrows point down-left and down-right: you may pass the traffic island on either side.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'a destra e a sinistra' (right and left): both sides are allowed, you choose.

sceneParams.caption: Either side of the traffic island is allowed

keywords.en: on the right and on the left

q20265.en: The sign shown allows drivers to pass both on the right and on the left of a passenger island.

explain.short: The two arrows point down-left and down-right: you may pass the passenger island on either side.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'a destra e a sinistra' (right and left): both sides are allowed, you choose.

sceneParams.caption: Either side of the passenger island is allowed

keywords.it: sia a destra che a sinistra
keywords.en: both on the right and on the left

q20266.en: The sign shown allows passing on the right and on the left of roadworks.

explain.short: The two arrows point down-left and down-right: you may pass the roadworks on either side.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'a destra e a sinistra' (right and left): both sides are allowed, you choose.

sceneParams.caption: Either side of the roadworks is allowed

keywords.en: on the right and on the left

q20267.en: The sign shown means that you can drive on the right and on the left of a traffic divider.

explain.short: The two arrows point down-left and down-right: you may pass the traffic divider on either side.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'a destra e a sinistra' (right and left): both sides are allowed, you choose.

sceneParams.caption: Either side of the traffic divider is allowed

keywords.en: on the right and on the left

q20268.en: The sign shown allows passing on both sides of the obstacle.

explain.short: The two arrows point down-left and down-right: you may pass the obstacle on either side.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'a destra e a sinistra' (right and left): both sides are allowed, you choose.

sceneParams.caption: Either side of the obstacle is allowed

q20269.en: The sign shown requires you to turn left or right at the junction.

explain.short: The arrows point down to the sides of an obstacle: you pass it, you do not turn at a junction.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'svoltare all'incrocio' (turn at the junction) is wrong: it is about passing an obstacle.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: pass the obstacle, no turn at a junction

q20270.en: The sign shown forbids you to continue along that road.

explain.short: You do continue: you pass the obstacle on the left or on the right.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (forbids) is the trap: this blue sign allows passages, it does not close the road.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: you continue on either side

q20271.en: The sign shown is, as a rule, preceded by the ROUNDABOUT sign.

explain.short: This sign stands at an obstacle in the road; it is not normally announced by the roundabout sign.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'di norma' (as a rule) is the trap: there is no such rule.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no roundabout sign before it

q20272.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: A blue disc is an obligation sign: it gives an order, not just information.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'indicazione' (information) signs are usually rectangles; round blue signs are obligations.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is an obligation sign

q20273.en: The sign shown is a prohibition sign.

explain.short: Prohibition signs have a red ring; this blue disc is an obligation sign.
explain.rule: 'Passaggi consentiti' (pass either side): you may pass the obstacle on the right OR on the left. These are the only passages allowed.
explain.trap: 'divieto' (prohibition) signs are red circles, not blue discs.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: blue = obligation, not prohibition
